cards.say: AI is fast and great with patterns. It is weaker at knowing when it's wrong. Good users understand both sides.
points: Strong at: drafting, summarizing, sorting, spotting patterns
Weak at: exact facts on demand, events after its training data, admitting what it doesn't know

cards.q: An assistant gives a confident answer with no source. What should you do before relying on it?
options: Trust it, since it sounded sure
Check it against a source you trust
cards.why: Confidence isn't evidence. Models can state wrong things fluently, so verify anything that matters.

cards.q: Myth or fact: an LLM always knows today's news.
cards.why: A model only knows what was in its training data, which stops at some date. Tools like web search can add fresh information.

cards.q: Which job is riskiest to hand to an AI with no human check?
options: Drafting a first reply to an email
Summarizing an article you will also skim
Working out a patient's medication dose
cards.why: When a wrong answer can cause real harm, a person must verify. Low-stakes drafting is where AI helps most.

cards.q: Put a safe AI workflow in order
steps: Ask the AI for a draft
Send it under your own name
cards.why: You stay accountable. The AI drafts, and you verify and decide.

cards.after: to your judgment, not a replacement for it.
cards.why: Use AI to speed up your work, and keep the final call yourself.
